text: Pressure Lab tropes (GDD 05 §5.3, R5Q3): patterns a run shows, as rules over its features. Features: share.<pool>.<band> (share of squad-ticks), breaks.<pool>, surges.<pool>, band_changes.<pool> (whole run), turns, reason, decided (1 if a side won before the turn limit), vp_gap, value_lost_ratio (the larger side's loss over the smaller's, 1 if none). Fire (U1 D6, summed over attackers): overkill_pct (overkill / (dealt + overkill), post-defence), kills_per_100 (enemy units killed per 100 of that damage), first_kill_s (the whole battle's first kill, seconds, absent if none), fire.wipes (enemy kills that took half a squad in one tick).

tropes.text: Morale barely moves: drift too strong or flows too weak.
Morale swings back and forth across bands.
Nobody gets ahead before the turn limit.
Fire piles onto units already doomed: 35% or more of the damage that got through is overkill (U1 D6).
Fire spreads thin: few kills per 100 damage, and the first kill comes late (U1 D6). The kill-rate floor is a placeholder until calibrated against the granularity floor.
Half of a squad dies in a single tick (U1 D6).
